page_title: ATA 2-1 CAG | Atalanta v Cagliari 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Davide Di Marco has a clear sight and sees a foul from Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari). Free kick. Atalanta will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90+3' Cagliari have a goal ruled out for offside!
90+3' A player from Atalanta commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Cagliari have a free kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

90' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but he sent it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
90' It will be a corner kick for Cagliari.
89' A player from Atalanta commits a rough challenge. Davide Di Marco blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Cagliari have a free kick from a promising distance.
88' Fabio Pisacane prepares a substitution. Sebastiano Luperto is replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
88' Substitution. Michel Adopo makes his way off the pitch and Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) comes on as his replacement.
87' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) trips an opposition player and Davide Di Marco signals a foul. Cagliari are awarded a free kick.
86' Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.

86' Close! Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out. Atalanta will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
85' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the left post is thwarted by Elia Caprile.

81' 2 - 1 What an excellent finish! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) latched on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and rifled an unstoppable low drive into the middle of the net and past the helpless goalkeeper.
79' Substitution. Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) has come on for Odilon Kossounou.
79' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) replaces Davide Zappacosta.
79' The ball goes out of play and Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
76' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

75' 1 - 1 Goal! A terrific long pass from Sebastiano Esposito picks out an unmarked Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
73' Dangerous play by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari). Davide Di Marco blows his whistle for a foul. Atalanta are awarded the free kick.
72' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
70' Yunus Musah (Atalanta) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Davide Di Marco blows for a foul. Cagliari earn a free kick.
70' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) passes the ball onto Ademola Lookman, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
68' Yunus Musah (Atalanta) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch for Juan Rodriguez.
66' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Ederson will be replaced by Yunus Musah (Atalanta).
66' It's time for a substitution. Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) comes on in place of Lorenzo Bernasconi.
65' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
62' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
60' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) touches the ball with his hand. Atalanta have been awarded a free kick.
58' Substitution. Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) in, Gennaro Borrelli out.
58' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gabriele Zappa.
57' Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) is given a yellow card.
55' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) is being substituted because of an injury. Raffaele Palladino sends Honest Ahanor on the pitch.
54' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) picks up an injury.

52' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Marco Palestra was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
50' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) brings an opponent down and Davide Di Marco interrupts the game. Atalanta are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
48' A quickly taken corner by Cagliari.
48' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Michel Adopo (Cagliari), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Cagliari win a corner kick.
46' Atalanta concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Cagliari have a free kick.
46' Referee Davide Di Marco blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Michael Folorunsho picks out Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) on the edge of the six-yard box, but the headed attempt bends just round the right post.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Atalanta fail to score from a corner as Elia Caprile (Cagliari) leaps to collect the ball.
43' A pass into the penalty area from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is intercepted by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.
41' Atalanta quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

41' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is obviously very disappointed with his shot from the rebound. He aims exactly at the goalkeeper's gloves. This should have been an easy goal! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atalanta.
40' Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.

39' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.

39' A short pass finds Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
36' Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) commits a rough foul. Davide Di Marco stops the game and makes a call. Atalanta will take a free kick.
34' Davide Di Marco blows his whistle as Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. There is a free kick near the sideline to Atalanta.
33' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) is booked by the referee.
33' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
29' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
27' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
27' The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.

27' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
25' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. It's a free kick to Cagliari, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
22' Atalanta will take a free kick near the side line. Davide Di Marco blows his whistle and it's Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

19' Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
18' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
13' The foul by Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) was seen by Davide Di Marco who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. It's a free kick to Cagliari, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
11' 1 - 0 Goal! Davide Zappacosta takes aim and his effort deflects off Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) to beat the goalkeeper. 1:0.
10' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) probably handled the ball. Atalanta are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
9' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

8' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Elia Caprile to get hold of the ball.
6' Davide Di Marco interrupts the game. One of the players from Atalanta won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Cagliari.
4' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

3' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Cagliari will take the kick-off.
Davide Di Marco got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
